fresh_test.quality_rule: PASS only if: (a) zero verified errors (wrong known player, unknown named, mixed track, bench/non-player) among links the candidate adds or changes relative to v2; (b) synthetic-unknown false matches not higher than v2; (c) at least 5 added links verified correct. Any added verified error -> FAIL. Fewer than 5 verified added links, or more than half of added links unverifiable -> INCONCLUSIVE.
fresh_test.coverage_target: >= 10% more verified-correct names than v2 on the same population (development: +19% overall, +17% on the three HBF matches)
fresh_test.honesty_note: with ~5-15 added links expected, zero errors bounds added-link precision only to about 0.74-0.82 (one-sided 95%). A pass shows no gross failure; it cannot prove non-inferiority. Labels are assistant blind labels unless the user adjudicates.
